results.question: 최근 3개월 카테고리별 매출 보여줘
results.sql:
SELECT c.CATEGORY_CD AS 카테고리코드, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS 카테고리명, CAST(ROUND(SUM(oi.AMOUNT)) AS INTEGER) AS 매출액
FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi
JOIN TB_ORDER o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON oi.PROD_ID = p.PROD_ID
JOIN TB_CATEGORY c ON p.CATEGORY_CD = c.CATEGORY_CD
WHERE o.STATUS NOT IN ('04','05')
  AND o.ORDER_DATE >= date('now', '-3 months')
GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_CD, c.CATEGORY_NAME
ORDER BY 매출액 DESC

results.question: 최근 6개월 월별 매출 추이
results.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', O.ORDER_DATE) AS 주문월,
       CAST(ROUND(SUM(OI.AMOUNT)) AS INTEGER) AS 매출액
FROM TB_ORDER O
JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID
WHERE O.STATUS NOT IN ('04','05')
  AND O.ORDER_DATE >= date('now', '-6 months')
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', O.ORDER_DATE)
ORDER BY 주문월

results.question: 이번 달 가장 많이 팔린 상품 TOP 5
results.sql:
SELECT p.PROD_ID AS 상품ID, p.PROD_NAME AS 상품명, SUM(oi.QTY) AS 판매수량, CAST(ROUND(SUM(oi.AMOUNT)) AS INTEGER) AS 매출액
FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi
JOIN TB_ORDER o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON oi.PROD_ID = p.PROD_ID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.ORDER_DATE) = strftime('%Y-%m', 'now')
  AND o.STATUS NOT IN ('04','05')
GROUP BY p.PROD_ID, p.PROD_NAME
ORDER BY 판매수량 DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: 지역별 반품률 비교해줘
results.sql:
SELECT c.REGION_CD AS 지역코드, cd.CD_NAME AS 지역명,
 COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID) AS 전체주문수,
 SUM(CASE WHEN o.STATUS='05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 반품주문수,
 ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.STATUS='05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID) * 100, 2) AS 반품률
FROM TB_ORDER o
JOIN TB_CUSTOMER c ON o.CUST_ID = c.CUST_ID
LEFT JOIN TB_CODE cd ON cd.GRP_CD='REGION' AND cd.CD = c.REGION_CD
GROUP BY c.REGION_CD, cd.CD_NAME
ORDER BY 반품률 DESC

results.question: 등급별 고객 수 알려줘
results.sql:
SELECT c.GRADE AS 등급코드, tc.CD_NAME AS 등급명, COUNT(*) AS 고객수
FROM TB_CUSTOMER c
LEFT JOIN TB_CODE tc ON tc.GRP_CD = 'GRADE' AND tc.CD = c.GRADE
GROUP BY c.GRADE, tc.CD_NAME
ORDER BY 고객수 DESC

results.question: 앱 채널 주문 비중이 늘고 있는지 월별로 보여줘
results.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.ORDER_DATE) AS 주문월,
       c.CD_NAME AS 채널,
       COUNT(*) AS 주문건수,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.ORDER_DATE)), 1) AS 비중_퍼센트
FROM TB_ORDER o
JOIN TB_CODE c ON c.GRP_CD = 'CHANNEL' AND c.CD = o.CHANNEL
GROUP BY 주문월, 채널
ORDER BY 주문월, 채널
LIMIT 100

results.question: 김민준 고객의 최근 3개월 주문 건수 알려줘
results.sql:
SELECT o.CUST_ID, c.CUST_NAME AS 고객명, COUNT(*) AS 주문건수
FROM TB_ORDER o
JOIN TB_CUSTOMER c ON o.CUST_ID = c.CUST_ID
WHERE o.CUST_ID IN ('C0001','C0002')
  AND o.ORDER_DATE >= date('now', '-3 months')
GROUP BY o.CUST_ID, c.CUST_NAME
ORDER BY o.CUST_ID

results.question: 뷰티 카테고리의 이번 달 매출 알려줘
results.sql:
SELECT c.CATEGORY_NAME AS 카테고리명, CAST(ROUND(SUM(oi.AMOUNT)) AS INTEGER) AS 매출
FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi
JOIN TB_ORDER o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON oi.PROD_ID = p.PROD_ID
JOIN TB_CATEGORY c ON p.CATEGORY_CD = c.CATEGORY_CD
WHERE c.CATEGORY_NAME = '뷰티'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.ORDER_DATE) = strftime('%Y-%m','now')
  AND o.STATUS NOT IN ('04','05')
GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_NAME
